name: Aga Lachowska
review:
**Verdict:** Meets the recruiting-exposure bar — a full-cycle recruitment role plus 6+ years of HR/onboarding experience in healthcare and hospitality settings.

**Strengths:** Explicitly "Managed full-cycle recruitment" as HR Coordinator (Grosvenor House Suites London); current Onboarding Specialist at Centria Healthcare (healthcare industry exposure); Psychology degree; strong HR systems, compliance, and employee-lifecycle background.

**Gaps:** Her most recent role (Onboarding Specialist) is not itself a recruiting title, so recruiting experience is a bit further back in her history; Spanish is Basic only.

**Phone screen questions:** 1) Walk me through your full-cycle recruitment work at Grosvenor House Suites — what did sourcing and screening look like day to day? 2) What draws you to moving from onboarding/HR coordination back into a dedicated recruiting role, specifically in behavioral health?

**Recommendation:** Advance — meets the recruiting-exposure requirement, solid HR/healthcare background.
